people.name: Cain
people.line: Adam and Eve's firstborn son, killed his brother Abel

people.name: Eden
people.line: The perfect garden where God placed Adam and Eve.

people.name: Nod
people.line: The land where Cain settled after killing Abel

translations.web: Cain left Yahweh’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
translations.bsb: So Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
translations.kjv: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
translations.asv: And Cain went out from the presence of Jehovah, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
